title.zh: 捕食者与猎物 · 延迟带来的起伏

description.zh: 猎物多时捕食者吃得饱、数量上升，捕食者多了又把猎物吃少，随后自己也饿下去——两个种群互相牵制，又各慢一拍，于是数量此起彼伏，捕食者的峰总落在猎物的峰之后。
description.en: When prey are plentiful predators thrive and multiply, more predators then eat the prey down, and later starve themselves — each population holds the other in check with a lag, so their numbers rise and fall in turn, the predator peak always trailing the prey peak.

aliases.zh: 为什么捕食者的峰比猎物晚
aliases.en: why predator peaks lag prey peaks

label.zh: 带延迟的负反馈会振荡

reason.zh: 捕食者把猎物压下来，是一条负反馈；但它要过一段时间才跟上猎物的变化，延迟让调节总是过头，于是数量围着平衡点起伏——和控制系统里延迟导致振荡是同一个道理。
reason.en: Predators pushing prey down is negative feedback, but they respond only after a lag, so the correction always overshoots and numbers swing around the balance point — the same reason delay makes a control loop oscillate.

label.zh: 把两条时间曲线画成一个圈
label.en: Two time curves drawn as one loop

reason.zh: 以猎物数为横轴、捕食者数为纵轴，此起彼伏的两条时间曲线就成了相平面上绕平衡点的闭圈；加上拥挤项（即 K），闭圈变成向内收的螺旋。
reason.en: Put prey on one axis and predators on the other and the two alternating time curves become a closed loop around the equilibrium in the phase plane; add a crowding term (K) and the loop becomes an inward spiral.
